svg.title: How to delete Gemini chat history and turn off saving: Check app activity settings
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to delete Gemini chat history and turn off saving:
Check app activity settings
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-30
Find the Gemini app activity screen
On a computer, sign in at gemini.google.com,
then go to Settings & help and Activity.
Delete only the period you need
On the activity screen, tap Delete to choose
from All time, Last hour or Last day, Custom
range, a specific date, or specific activity.
Check the auto-delete period
According to the help page, Gemini app activity
older than 18 months is automatically deleted by
default.
Turn off activity retention so future
chats are not saved
At the top of the activity screen, changing
Activity retention to Turn off lets you
configure new conversations not to be saved to…
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
